create_cron_job.description: Creates billable standing automation with caller-selected repository, schedule and commands; auto-deploy defaults to yes. Review plan, schedule and code source.

create_key_value.description: Provisions a database with a caller-selected plan, eviction policy and persistence mode (including off). Free-tier creation is still a resource mutation.

create_postgres.description: Provisions a database with a caller-selected plan, version and disk size. Review capacity and recurring spend, including omitted/default plan.

create_static_site.description: Builds and publishes caller-selected repository content to a public site; auto-deploy defaults to yes.

create_web_service.description: Creates public executable infrastructure with a selected plan, repository and build/start commands; auto-deploy defaults to yes.

trigger_deploy.description: Rebuilds and deploys service code, optionally clearing cache. Affects live service availability and code; recoverable rather than inherently irreversible.

update_environment_variables.description: Merges variables by default; replace=true deletes omitted variables, including secrets that may not be recoverable. Both modes trigger a deployment. Success returns deploy metadata, not the existing secret values.

select_workspace.description: Changes persisted/session workspace fallback and therefore the target of later calls lacking workspaceId. Govern re-targeting even though this tool is deprecated.

list_workspaces.description: Despite its name, automatically sets the selected workspace when exactly one workspace is returned (pkg/owner/tools.go). This mutates the target fallback for subsequent calls.

query_render_postgres.description: Accepts unrestricted SQL using database connection credentials obtained internally. Upstream begins a READ ONLY transaction, but SQL can still invoke functions with external effects (for example dblink where installed and authorized); READ ONLY is not a general SQL sandbox. Govern execution, not ordinary data sensitivity.
